recipes.applicability: Affected architecture, requirements, plan or task guidance; actual code establishes the scope.
recipes.preservedBehavior: Valid requirements, product confirmation, task IDs, completed work, consumer edits and original authority.
recipes.allowedScope: Affected owners, contracts and dependency closure only.
ordering: Run normal consistency/preflight and behavioral tests
verification: Declared graph plus actual effect placement
recipes.recoveryLimits: Workspace edits can be reverted under consumer authority. External state requires separate rollout and recovery.

recipes.applicability: Explicit optional adoption or demonstrated unsupported exact dependency selection.
recipes.preservedBehavior: Accepted architecture, supported retained profile and existing locks until an exact reviewed transition.
recipes.allowedScope: Selected dependency artifacts and actual reverse contract closure.
ordering: Run affected native and behavioral checks
recipes.recoveryLimits: Keep original transition evidence; native package retention does not roll back deployed services or databases.

recipes.applicability: Consumer descriptor production/receiver contract changes at the selected exact engineering profile.
recipes.preservedBehavior: Public contract identity and provider behavior; engineering dependencies remain outside runtime.
recipes.allowedScope: Shared producer/receiver contract and affected projects/domains, grouped once.
ordering: Inspect actual produced descriptors and selected dependencies
verification: Independent consumer behavior and handoff checks
recipes.recoveryLimits: Git restoration cannot undo published packages or deployed receiver state; scope external activation separately.
